decisions.reason: No suitable API found for fetching genre of a Deezer editorial; semantic top-1 and LLM choice are identical and inadequate.
LLM choice matches semantic top-1; Shazam API is the closest available despite mismatch with Soundcloud and song_id parameter.
LLM choice 'Shazam - Artist Info' API is clearly more appropriate for extracting artist information from song details than semantic top-1.
